# What real Cloudflare Workers Builds builds saw, read 2026-11-08. check_analytics_gate.sh reads
# the ENV-NAMES lines: the branch variable src/config.ts reads must be in each. A build step wrote
# public/ci-env-build.txt (variable NAMES only, never values, plus the branch and commit); it was
# read back with curl. Throwaway repos and Workers; account and address left out.
